overview: Cab driver Max picks up a man who offers him $600 to drive him around. But the promise of easy money sours when Max realizes his fare is an assassin.
tagline: It started like any other night.

recs.blurb: An Argentinian crime drama revolving around a sheet of rare stamps (the Nine Queens).
A three-tiered story centered around drugs and organized crime, and focused on a young man who becomes a runner for a coke dealer.
Two brothers, on either side of the law, face off over organized crime in Brooklyn during the 1970s.
A corrupt cop gets in over his head when he tries to assassinate a beautiful Russian hit-woman.
In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is seduced by a woman seeking retribution.
Max and Page are a brilliant mother/daughter con team who have their grift down to a fine science. Max targets wealthy, willing men and marries them. Page then…
When CIA Analyst Jack Ryan interferes with an IRA assassination, a renegade faction targets Jack and his family as revenge.
Renegade FBI agent Art Jeffries protects a nine-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new "unbreakable" code.
A former thief frantically searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi.
A serial murderer is strangling women with a necktie. The London police have a suspect, but he is the wrong man.
A weak-willed Italian man becomes a fascist flunky who goes abroad to arrange the assassination of his old teacher, now a political dissident.
